ShortDescription.Value: See every district's happiness, top complaint, assigned services, assets, and active policies at a glance

Publish.LongDescription:
District Manager adds a map-pin button to the toolbar. Click it and you get a panel listing every district in your city in one place.
Each district's entry shows: - Population and average citizen happiness, color-coded - Services assigned to the district through the game's own "assign district" tool, not buildings that just happen to be nearby - Parks and any signature or landmark buildings in the district - Whatever policies are currently active there
Districts sort alphabetically and start collapsed, so expand the ones you care about, or use Expand All / Collapse All. Click a district's pin, or any service or asset chip, and the camera jumps straight to it on the map. There's a manual refresh button if you want to force an update, and you can turn the mod on or off anytime from Options > Mods > District Manager.
It's read-only: it just shows what's already in your city and doesn't change anything.

ChangeLog.Value: Expand all / Collapse all are now real buttons instead of non-functional checkboxes. Removed a misleading 'No city services located in this district' complaint that showed even when nothing was actually wrong.
